card.name: Unit or symbol right after a number
card.fires_on: The word or symbol that comes right after a digit and finishes a number expression, such as percent, %, x, billion, ft, or a colon in a time. It also fires on the letter inside gene or enzyme names like 2D6.

modes.label: Number units
modes.description: A unit or magnitude word directly after a figure.
modes.example: 5<< billion>> over the next twenty years on its navy

modes.label: Letter inside a code
modes.description: A single letter between digits in enzyme or mutation names.

modes.label: Time or sci notation
modes.description: A colon in a clock time or an x in a count like 5x10^9.
